chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Amr ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn Uzafir from Umar ibn Yazeed who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'O Umar! When it is the night of Friday, angels descend from the sky in the number of particles, in their hands are pens of gold and sheets of silver. They do not write up to the night of Saturday except for the Blessings upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), so increase in it.'

And he said: 'O Umar! Indeed, it is from the Sunnah that you send Blessings upon Muhammad and upon the People of his Household on every Friday a thousand times, and on the other days one hundred times.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended number of Salawat recitations on Friday according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the cosmic significance of Friday night by describing angels descending with golden pens to record Salawat, thereby linking human devotion to celestial activity. He establishes a specific Sunnah of reciting one thousand blessings on Fridays and one hundred on other days, reinforcing the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia devotional practice. This instruction underscores the continuity of prophetic tradition and the spiritual merit attached to honoring the Prophet and his pure progeny through consistent dhikr.
